t: La Joux Perret G100 Worth An Extra $350 Over Sellita SW200? | WatchUSeek Watch Forums
s: Did you notice how similar this LJP movement is to the Miyota 9015! ... At first I was sceptical that it would be a 9015 copy at such prices. But I found pictures of both without a rotor, and there can be no doubt. Notice how all jewels are at the exact same spots - this is a copy, with some minor changes to the main bridge, and of course the finishing and power reserve. The 9015 is a good movement, and I actually prefer it over the 2824. But I'd just buy the citizen version for much cheaper rather than this one.
